results.title: Orbit Irrigation is rated "Excellent" with 4.6 / 5 on Trustpilot
results.content:
Evaluating 62 reviews, reviewers overwhelmingly had a great experience with this company. Consumers frequently praise the extremely helpful support team and quick, hassle-free warranty replacements when items stop working unexpectedly. Many people also love the convenient smart features, reliable performance, and easy installation of their irrigation controllers and timers. Some people were dissa tisfied with product durability, noting that devices like hoses, nozzles, and timers frequently failed, broke, or leaked over time. Customers also mentioned frustrating troubleshooting sessions, unhelpful agents, and long wait times when trying to reach support for assistance. Additionally, some users reported connection issues and ongoing software errors that made managing their watering systems [...] ## Orbit Irrigation – Disappointing Customer Experience
I recently had a very frustrating experience with Orbit Irrigation that highlights serious gaps in their customer service approach.  
I placed an order by mistake and realized it almost immediately. Within minutes, I contacted Orbit to cancel the order, assuming this would be a straightforward request given how quickly I acted. However, I was told there was nothing they could do to stop the order—even though it ultimately did not ship for another three days. This lack of flexibility was surprising and disappointing.
